subject: Applynx audit: deployment guardrails & topology vignettes
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@applynx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Applynx Security <security@applynx.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@applynx.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit intake — topology + SOC2/SIG/CAIQ artifacts for Dedicated/Private

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off our audit intake for Applynx's Private deployment evaluation. The auditor has asked for: 1) an annotated network topology that highlights tenant demarcation for Dedicated and Private modes, 2) a short narrative (1 page) describing isolation controls and control-plane egress points, and 3) SIG/CAIQ mappings or pointers to the SOC 2 evidence bundle.

Two constraints from the audit team: diagrams must call out egress chokepoints and any approved third-party interconnects, and they want an explicit statement about whether a customer can bring their own KMS in Private mode.

Can your team deliver these materials by EOD Friday (2028-05-24)? If that timeline is tight we can push out the auditor meeting by a week.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Jensen
Director, Information Security
Applynx
laura.jensen@applynx.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-05-20T09:45:00-07:00

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the annotated topology + 1-page narrative and point you to the SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 evidence set.

Plan:

- Internal: I'll loop in our security architect and evidence pack owner (cc'd).

Is an end-of-day Friday delivery for the initial packet workable? If not, please confirm latest acceptable delivery date and whether the auditor needs any live demo windows.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Applynx audit — need annotated topology + CAIQ mapping (deadline Fri)

Kimberly / Marissa — Laura at Applynx requested annotated topology + 1-page narrative and SIG/CAIQ pointers. Auditor asked specifically that we: (A) mark tenant demarcation slices for Dedicated and Private, (B) call out control-plane egress points (regions + approved interconnects), and (C) confirm BYOK/KMS support posture for Private.

Deliverables: (assign below)
- Kimberly: canonical annotated topology (PNG + SVG) showing: tenant overlays, management/control-plane separation, egress choke points, approved peering endpoints, and an "attestation paragraph" stating whether BYOK is supported (we are: yes for Private via customer-managed KMS with HSM integration). Use guardrail visual language (colors for trust zones). Target: draft by EOD Thu.
- Marissa: assemble evidence pointers (SIG/CAIQ mapping rows) and the SOC2 cover letter that references the artifacts and procedures. Include links to the Drive folder and a single-sheet index. Target: initial bundle by EOD Fri.

Notes: I attached the working sketch I drew on the call (guardrails_sketch_v1.svg) — keep it internal. Auditor is OK with a short narrative in plain English; they will not need raw configs. Also confirm whether any approved third-party cross-connects require additional paperwork.

If either of you foresee blockers, flag them now and I'll escalate.

Thanks — Ben

[Attachment: guardrails_sketch_v1.svg]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@applynx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-21T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Applynx audit packet: deployment guardrails, topology vignettes, and evidence links

Laura — attaching the initial packet for your auditor. Quick summary below and a link to the shared Drive where we've grouped the artifacts. If you want us to walk through any diagram or the CAIQ mapping, we're available Wed 5/24 or Thu 5/25 for a 30-minute session.

Attachments included (brief descriptors):
- deployment_guardrails_diagram_v3.png (annotated topology: Dedicated vs Private overlays, egress choke points, control-plane separation)
- tenant_demarcation_table.xlsx (rows: tenant class, boundary controls, allowed interconnects, logging/retention notes)
- SOC2_cover_letter_Applynx.pdf (cover letter that references the SOC 2 controls and where to find the evidence)

Key points called out in the narrative:
- Tenant demarcation: Dedicated runs in isolated GPU pools with logical tenant overlays; Private deploys run in customer VPC with our private control-plane proxy. 
- Control-plane egress: All control-plane telemetry and management traffic egress through regional control-plane endpoints; approved interconnects are listed in the diagram.
- BYOK/KMS: Private deployments support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) via our KMS integration. The narrative includes the required handshake steps for key rotation and proof-of-possession.

Drive link (read-only for your auditor): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2_example_shared_drive_link
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/APP-98765

Next step: Please confirm if the auditor needs any live network captures or config snippets (they often do not for topology). If they want a live demo, we'd propose Wed 5/24 10:00 AM PT (we'll send a calendar invite).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Attachments: deployment_guardrails_diagram_v3.png, tenant_demarcation_table.xlsx, SOC2_cover_letter_Applynx.pdf]
